sources.entry: Agent Skills for Knowledge Work by Hieu T. Luu - Skills for knowledge work rather than just coding, covering a variety of cognitive approaches to problem-solving: brainstorming, critical thinking, problem diagnosis, design thinking, market research, deep reading, Socratic tutoring, and more.

summary.one_liner: A collection of method-driven agent skills for knowledge work (brainstorming, critical thinking, market research, deep reading, product and project management, and more) rather than coding alone.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides a set of skills, each a SKILL.md-based method an AI agent follows for a specific job. The README lists about 19 skills, including brainstorm-coach, critical-thinking, problem-solver, design-thinking, market-researcher, product-manager, project-manager, scrum-master, data-scientist, deep-reader, strategy-board, diataxis-writer, system-prompt-creator, slidewright, fiction-studio, socratic-questor, cv-scorer, bmad-run-inspector, and manual-tester. A table maps common jobs to the skill to start with. Skills can be installed individually with npx skills add, or the full collection can be installed as a Claude Code plugin. The README says the skills are designed for users who supply real context and keep responsibility for decisions, with the agent providing structure, analysis, and quality checks. It also states they are tested on Claude and DeepSeek models.
use_cases: Brainstorm and challenge product or business ideas
Diagnose a recurring problem and verify its root cause
Run cited desk research on a market or competitors
Learn a topic through guided Socratic questions
how_to_run: /market-researcher Assess the market for this product idea in Vietnam.
notable: Covers knowledge work and decision-making rather than only coding
Each skill can be installed individually or as a full collection
Includes a manual tester skill that checks findings against the database and requires a local dev stack
bmad-run-inspector is only useful inside projects that run bmad-loop
Multilingual README (English, Tiếng Việt, 中文)
caveats: Some skills need specific setup: manual-tester needs a local dev stack and bmad-run-inspector needs a project running bmad-loop
Compatibility depends on each host tool's implementation of the Agent Skills specification
Tested on Claude and DeepSeek models only, per the README
Non-Claude/Codex/ChatGPT hosts may need manual installation into their skills directory
